name: Mistbound
source:
The mist never lets anyone go.

You wake up in a fog-covered swamp. The trees are all the same. The path never leads anywhere. And in the distance, a figure stands motionless in the mist.

You don't know how you got here. You don't know if you can leave...

[From [url=https://yorubox.itch.io/mistbound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
迷雾永远不会让任何人离开。

你在一片雾气弥漫的沼泽中醒来。树都是一样的。这条路永远不会通向任何地方。而远处，一道人影一动不动地站在雾气之中。

你不知道你是怎么来到这里的。你不知道你是否可以离开…

[来自[url=https://yorubox.itch.io/mistbound]itch.io[/url]]
